subject_lessons.title: Y11 Math (Pre-Calculus & Linear Algebra): Matrices, Dot Products & Taylor Polynomials
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL PRE-CALCULUS & LINEAR ALGEBRA LESSON (GRADE 11):
• Dot Product: `q · k = Σ q_i * k_i` measures similarity between two vectors.
• Second-Order Taylor Series of `e^s` around `s = 0`:
    `exp(s) ≈ 1 + s + 0.5 * s²`
  By replacing `exp(q·k / √d)` with its 2nd-order Taylor polynomial, PRIME Moment Attention factors the sum into fixed-size moment tensors `(S₀, S₁, S₂)` that require O(1) memory (`67 KB`) regardless of sequence length!

# 📐 YEAR 11 PRE-CALCULUS LAB: 2nd-Order Taylor Approximation of exp(s)
import math
for s in [-0.5, -0.2, 0.0, 0.2, 0.5]:
    exact = math.exp(s)
    taylor2 = 1.0 + s + 0.5 * (s ** 2)
    err = abs(exact - taylor2)
    print(f's={s:5.2f} -> exp(s)={exact:.4f} | Taylor2={taylor2:.4f} | Error={err:.4f}')

subject_lessons.title: Y11 Biology & Neuroscience: Hebbian Synaptic Plasticity, Homeostasis & Lotka-Volterra
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL NEUROSCIENCE & SYSTEMS BIOLOGY LESSON (GRADE 11):
• Hebbian Plasticity ("Neurons that fire together, wire together"): Outer-product covariance updates `ΔS₁ = k_t v_t^T` store associative memories in synaptic matrices.
• Homeostatic Regulation: Biological brains prevent runaway seizure excitation using inhibitory normalization—just like QK-Norm and Lyapunov norm projection in PRIME Attention!

# 🔬 YEAR 11 NEUROSCIENCE LAB: Homeostatic Norm Projection (Lyapunov Stability)
import math
state_vec = [12.0, 16.0, 20.0]
frob_norm = math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in state_vec))
c_max = 15.0
scale = min(1.0, c_max / frob_norm)
projected = [round(x * scale, 2) for x in state_vec]
print(f'Raw Norm: {frob_norm:.2f} -> Projected to C_max={c_max}: {projected}')

subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL PUBLIC POLICY & ETHICS LESSON (GRADE 11):
• Privacy Laws (FERPA & COPPA) protect student records from unauthorized cloud collection.
• Software Licensing: Open-source licenses (MIT, ISC, GPL) allow inspection and modification, whereas proprietary EULAs forbid copying or reverse-engineering code— while general mathematical and architectural ideas remain free for clean-room implementation.
